sandboxReset.command: manual disposable-fixture sandbox verification for task 23 (reset-based verifier skipped because persistent sandbox drift blocks the normal reset path)
sandboxReset.stdout: Created a disposable sandbox customer and open invoice, reconciled a one-row CSV bank statement against that invoice, and confirmed the invoice outstanding amount dropped from 1000 to 0.
highlights: Manual disposable-fixture verification used instead of the reset-based verifier.
First manual attempt exposed a real strategy blocker: GET /supplierInvoice without invoiceDateFrom/invoiceDateTo returned 422.
After adding supplier-invoice date bounds, the rerun completed successfully and settled the invoice in the sandbox.

checks.description: Read back the disposable invoice after task-23 reconciliation and confirm the outstanding amount is zero.

verdict.message: Manual sandbox verification proved the customer-payment branch on a disposable fixture, but the challenger used 6 calls against a 3-call lower bound for the exact one-row customer-payment shape.
